verdict.rationale: Model-file compatibility across runtime upgrades is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, but the evidence pack never mentions it. Nothing covers runtime versioning, GGUF or MLX format compatibility guarantees, or re-download requirements after upgrades. The API changelog and REST versioning cover API endpoints only, not quantized model files, so that evidence is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
